tweets.text: For our free newsletter this week, we write about how governments have an interest in investing directly in AI. @IrenaCronin and I write this newsletter every week. AI is becoming an investment race as governments seek more influence over the companies and infrastructure shaping the future economy. The U.S. is debating whether the public should have a stake in major AI companies, while the U.K. and South Korea are already investing directly in AI infrastructure, computing capacity, and chips to strengthen their national competitiveness. Read and subscribe for free: unaligned.io
